scenario.summary: A seeker asks the oracle to reveal the path to the sunken vault.

dialogue.speaker: seeker
dialogue.text: Oracle, where lies the sunken vault?

dialogue.speaker: vesh
dialogue.text: Seeker, the constellations whisper of a drowned stair beneath the twin moons.

dialogue.speaker: vesh
dialogue.text: The path holds a clue in salt and shadow; tread with care.
